checks.decision: Soft load pressure reduces work; memory floor remains a hard gate.
Counter resets/missing samples yield unknown CPU usage, not a fabricated zero. Recovery uses two safe samples and a short check interval.
One resource state drives work limits and display; unfinished collection cannot pass operational completion.
Verify full new-provider dates and closes against an identity-bound KIS KRX reference; do not mutate either window.
One page per cycle with a hash-bound checkpoint; no total page/time expiry; malformed or contradictory rows cannot be approved.
A fresh trading observation requires a linked valid regular-session price; issuer state/time/evidence are retained.
Legacy checked_at remains a fallback. Stale trading, unverified issuer and hard collection blockers remain pending.
